_note: provider: 'dodo' (Dodo Payments). dodo.productId.<mode>: the id of the Pushreel product in the Dodo dashboard (pdt_...), one per mode; a string or a list of strings. Without it activation is refused, because Dodo's licence endpoints accept the keys of every merchant. dodo.mode: 'live' or 'test' (PUSHREEL_DODO_MODE overrides). revalidateDays: days between silent re-checks while online, 0 switches them off. Machines per key (3) is the activation limit of the licence key entitlement in the Dodo dashboard, not a value in this file. See docs/LICENSING.md.
